name: pluma
description: Pluma language support for Cuervo Engine games: syntax highlighting, the Pluma language server (diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, rename, formatting) and the script debugger.

pluma.toolsPath.markdownDescription: The `cuervo-tools` executable that runs the language server (`cuervo-tools lsp <project>`). A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; `${workspaceFolder}` and a leading `~` are expanded, e.g. `${workspaceFolder}/build/debug/tools/cuervo_tools/cuervo-tools`.

pluma.runtimePath.markdownDescription: The `cuervo` runtime the debugger launches (`cuervo --dap`). A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; `${workspaceFolder}` and a leading `~` are expanded, e.g. `${workspaceFolder}/build/debug/runtime/cuervo`.

pluma.projectPath.markdownDescription: The project directory (the one with `project.toml`) the language server analyzes. Empty: the first workspace folder. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded.

pluma.checkStyle.markdownDescription: Report naming-style warnings (`PascalCase` types, `snake_case` functions and variables, `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` constants, `#snake_case` names).

project.description: The game's project directory (the one with project.toml).

backend.description: Render backend. Default: Vulkan, falling back to OpenGL.

configurationSnippets.label: Pluma (Cuervo): Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Run a Cuervo Engine game under the Pluma debugger.
